etsy.description:
A funny Vim poster for every desperate :wq! escape from the editor, in dark-mode colors.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you

This listing is a physical poster print. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: Vim results are mostly cheat sheets (digital downloads, coasters, stickers); few joke-led Vim prints, so the :wq! gag is a differentiator.
Top programmer-humor listings lead with the joke plus 'programmer gift' / 'developer gift' and 'wall art' in the title.
Many competing listings are digital downloads; stating 'physical poster print' separates this listing.
Vim on Amazon appears as an 8x12 metal cheat-sheet tin sign, not a humor print.
Amazon titles name the room ('office', 'home decor') and 'unframed'; debugging jokes dominate the humor niche.

research.notes: Listing pages were not reachable from this environment; evidence is from search results only. No priceRange: snippets did not separate physical prints from digital downloads.
